title: Input Port
text: Connection block from Simulink environment to RF physical blocks, {Treat input Simulink signal as} sets Options for interpreting the input Source; {Source impedance (ohms)} sets the source impedance of the RF network, {Finite impulse response filter length} sets the desired length of the baseband-equivalent impulse, {Fractional bandwidth of guard bands} sets the fraction of modeling bandwidth, {Modeling delay (samples)} sets the number of time samples by which to delay the impulse response of baseband-equivalent, {Center frequency (Hz)} sets the center of modeling, {Sample time (s)} sets the time interval between consecutive samples, {Input Processing} sets the type of processing mode Elements, {Add noise} and {Initial seed}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Treat input Simulink signal as
params.values: Options for interpreting the input Source voltage (default) | Incident power wave | scalar

params.name: Source impedance (ohms)
params.values: Source impedance of the RF network 50 (default) | scalar

params.name: Finite impulse response filter length
params.values: Desired length of the baseband-equivalent impulse response 128 (default) | scalar

params.name: Modeling delay (samples)
params.values: Number of time samples by which to delay the impulse response of baseband-equivalent model 0 (default) | scalar

params.name: Sample time (s)
params.values: Time interval between consecutive samples 1e-7 (default) | scalar

params.name: Input Processing
params.values: Specify type of processing mode Elements as channels (sample based) (default) | Columns as channels (frame based)

params.name: Add noise
params.values: Add noise data to block on (default) | off

params.name: Initial seed
params.values: Initial seed for random number generator block 67987 (default) | nonnegative integer
